summary: Retest ONLY of Worker Profile 'Other' job title persistence bug (BuildMitra Phase 1). Fix in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx (useState initializer + useEffect re-hydration on user?.skills change) verified via Playwright + backend API. All acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix logic in profile.tsx (lines 22-29 + useEffect 124-138) is correct: initialSkillIsCustom = !!initialSkill && !SKILLS.includes(initialSkill) properly maps non-canonical skills to 'Other' + customSkill; useEffect re-hydrates after late user load / refresh().
seed_data_creation: Restored worker (9000000002) skill back to ['Carpenter'] after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Worker Profile 'Other' persistence bug is FIXED and verified end-to-end. Auth used API-login + injecting JSON.stringify(token) into localStorage under key 'bm_token' (storage layer JSON-parses on read).
rca_of_issue: Original bug: useState initializer stored raw non-canonical skill (e.g., 'Chimney Fitter') into `skills[0]` instead of 'Other'. Dropdown value={skills[0]} then displayed 'Chimney Fitter' as-if it were a canonical option, and the custom input never rendered. Fix: pre-compute initialSkillIsCustom = skill && !SKILLS.includes(skill); initial state -> skills=['Other'], customSkill=skill. Added useEffect on user?.skills to re-hydrate after refresh() / async user load. Verified: 1) picked 'Other' + typed 'Chimney Fitter' -> save; 2) full page reload; 3) dropdown shows 'Other', input pre-filled 'Chimney Fitter', GET /api/me returns skills:['Chimney Fitter']; 4) reset to Carpenter, GET /api/me returns skills:['Carpenter'].
